title: Bad Bunny's birth chart
metaDescription: Bad Bunny's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 19.9° Pisces. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Water dominates the certain ground here, taking five of the nine placements whose signs are settled. A water emphasis reads as porousness: the room is registered whole, long before it is analysed in parts.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's position resolves to 19.9° Pisces — deep enough in the second decan (10°–20°) that the Moon, its traditional sub-ruler, colours the reading.

blocks.title: Closer to the ground
blocks.text: For the fast movers, Mercury was at 24.1° Aquarius, Venus was at 2.6° Aries, Mars was at 2.5° Pisces. Read together: thought that travels by comparison; attraction declared rather than implied; effort that surges when it matters.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Nothing in the geometry sits closer than Mars and Saturn: 2.4° from an exact conjunction. When two functions occupy one degree, the tradition reads a fusion: neither can act without committing the other. Behind it, Uranus conjunction Neptune at 2.5°, and Uranus sextile Pluto at 2.8° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. All of it stands whatever the hour was: each angle was tested from midnight to midnight before it was written down.

blocks.title: Figures in the geometry
blocks.text: No closed figure — no grand trine, t-square, or grand cross — holds among the day-stable angles. The chart distributes its tension pair by pair rather than through one standing structure.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The dignity table, which predates the outer planets and only ever spoke for seven, marks one placement here. Venus in Aries at 2.6° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain. None of this ranks anyone; dignity describes footing, and footing can be worked with.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Tallied where the signs are certain — 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day — the chart gives water 5, earth 2, air 1, fire 1, and mutable 3, fixed 3, cardinal 3 across the modes. Jupiter and Pluto were retrograde — motion that reverses only from this vantage point, and which the old reading treats as delay used for revision.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Aquarius into Pisces during that day at the birthplace, travelling 12.4° between one midnight and the next. Half the day belongs to each sign, and the split falls at an unrecorded hour — so this page holds the Moon as a genuine unknown.
